messages:
marta: Heads-up: AcmeMed's card auth for invoice INV-7865 failed with '3DS_required' then 'authentication_failed'. They say their AP team used a corporate AMEX.

josh-finance: Can you paste gateway response id? Is it a network decline or challenge flow?

marta: pg_tx_n7f21. Looks like gateway returned: challenge_required -> user did not complete 3DS flow. Amount $6,200.

billing-bot: Auto-retry policy: for 3DS_required we attempt 1 webhook reminder and 2 retries over 24h. Reminder sent to customer (msg id rem_551).

olivia-sales: Customer reached out in DM — treasury team is remote and can't complete 3DS in browser. They asked if we can provide a secure paylink or accept wire.

anita-ops: We have a hosted paylink option that supports SCA fallback for European cards. But AMEX corporate might still need 3DS. Paylink is OK if customer can complete it. Wire is fine for >$5k but needs finance+compliance approval.

josh-finance: Given amount >$5k, request compliance sign-off before sending wire. Paging @compliance-bot for flag. If we send paylink, cancel scheduled retries to avoid double-charges.

compliance-bot: Quick check: AcmeMed (MID ACME-77) onboarding KYC completed. No sanctions hits. Approve wire acceptance for one-off payment. Recommend adding note: "one-time wire, follow standard recon and hold for 48h."

olivia-sales: I'll offer both options to the customer: paylink (fast) or wire (treasury). Customer prefers paylink but needs a mobile-friendly flow.

anita-ops: Our paylink is mobile-friendly. I'll generate link and set it to expire in 24h. Also pausing retries until paylink result.

marta: Please paste the paylink here once created. Also include instructions: complete 3DS challenge if prompted.

anita-ops: Generated paylink: https://pay.redwood.ai/pay/INV-7865-XXXX (redacted). Expiry: 24h. Note: If paylink fails, we proceed with wire per compliance ok.

olivia-sales: Sent link and instructions to customer. Customer confirms they received and will try from their treasury mobile.

billing-bot: Workflow update: scheduled retries paused; paylink issued (link_id pl_220).

marta: Customer reported success — payment captured via paylink. Gateway txn id gw_11c2. Marking invoice paid and closing thread.

josh-finance: Good. Please attach capture receipt to the billing ticket and reconcile tomorrow morning.

compliance-bot: Note logged: one-time AMEX paylink flow for ACME-77 accepted; no further action.
